# Free Cash Envelope Tracker
> Private, zero-login digital cash stuffing application.

## Overview
Free Cash Envelope Tracker is a browser-based personal finance app for cash envelope budgeting and cash stuffing. It runs entirely client-side using browser local storage, with zero accounts, zero cloud databases, and zero tracking.

## Core Features
- Digital Cash Stuffing: Create, edit, and categorize cash envelopes (Essential, Discretionary, Savings, Debt).
- Expense Logging: Record transactions with dates and notes, updating envelope and total budget balances in real time.
- Visual Budget Tracking: Real-time progress bars and over-budget warnings.
- PDF Export: Choose between Classic Minimal (color-coded cards and transaction ledger) and Minimal B&W (print-friendly ruled lines).
- Excel Import/Export: Export budget states or import spreadsheets formatted via two sheets ('Envelopes' and 'Expenses').
- Privacy First: 100% browser local storage (`localStorage`). No sign-ups or bank connections.

## Access
- Website: https://freecashtracker.online
